name: Protocell
oneLine: A bubble with copying RNA inside. Not quite alive, but close.
howItWorks: The bubble keeps the RNA and its copies together. Bubbles whose RNA copies faster grow and split faster. Over time, they take over.
deeper: No one has built a protocell that grows, copies and divides on its own. Labs have shown each step separately.
sizeComparison: a 10th to 100th the width of a hair
simplification: Races here take minutes. Real ones would take many generations.
